text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The eventful summer training camp
is also about to come to an end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Manhattan Cafe's strict guidance
and Vodka's encouragement, Red Desire's
condition was visibly improving.
choice_data_list: Today's the grand finale of training camp!
Today is the final day of training camp!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: (I can feel it... The power of the Saint is amplifying...!)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(With these legs, I'll run my story to the end.
Claiming great brilliance, I shall reach the other world.)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: In the next Shuka Sho—without fail!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Haaaaahーー!!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Desire-san... With how you are now,
I'm sure... you can make it.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Way to go, Desire!!
Desire-chan...! Amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... What do you think!
This summer solstice ritual has been carried out without a hitch!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "Saint Red Desire has dispelled the darkness... and taken her step toward the next stage!"
choice_data_list: Yeah! You really worked so hard.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
It is all thanks to everyone's devotion.
In order to repay those who have lifted me up...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
—At the Shuka Sho,
I shall show you the running of a true saint!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Having completely recovered her form, Red Desire looked even more radiant than before the training camp.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Desire-chan.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Buena-san...!
What's the matter?"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: You know, I wanted to let you know.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: "I saw your run, Desire-chan. You've gotten so much faster than you were in the Oka Sho and the Oaks."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Looking straight at the dream you want to make come true, while borrowing strength from those precious to you.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
You were charging forward with everything you had.
You looked so dazzling.
Your running... blew all my doubts away.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Hesitation...?
What is it that's troubling you...?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: "I've been agonizing over going to the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe all this time. Should I cross the sea and challenge the big stage? Or should I...?"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Running right in front of the people who've always stayed by my side, cheering me on so, so much—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Shall we all reach that 'breathtaking view' together?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Watching your run made up my mind.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I will run all the way down the path I first dreamed of.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Cut through the doubts and run the Shuka Sho—the Triple Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: "Let's battle for the final crown, Desire-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I swore I would run even on a path without you.
And yet...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Once again, you stand before me.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "Through my running, guided and elevated even further by Cafe-san and Vodka-san...!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah... This is truly
the tale of the Saint, Red Desire—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I can still run even without you. But—
if you're there, the race burns so much hotter!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Gladly, Buena-san!
Let's run together and shake the whole world!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yeah, nice to meet you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days after concluding the fruitful summer training camp—

text_block_list.name: Race Fan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you hear!?
Buena Vista officially announced
she's entering the Shuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan
text_block_list.text: And she even commented that she's looking forward to a rematch with Red Desire...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The media sensationalized it as a fated showdown, driving the public's excitement to unprecedented heights.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Red Desire. She is no longer just a humble saint quietly drawing attention.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Shouldering destiny to challenge the strongest heroine,
as a protagonist standing as her equal,
people began following the path she blazed."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu. I can hear them, Trainer.
The swelling cheers of anticipation... All of this is a melody of blessing
that elevates me toward an alternative world."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Let us go.
To the final trial of the Triple Tiara!
